verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a personal AI assistant that stores chats, agents and indexed content, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a Khoj export feature or open export formats. Self-hosting, local data and indexing of the user's own markdown/org files are adjacent privacy and data-source features, not a first-party export-and-leave capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
